title: When Piper glances Bard reflections of expressions in contrary states bounce back from Blake's plates. Constraints on creativity in a marriage of fate
summary: When Piper glances Bard reflections of expressions in contrary states bounce back from Blake's plates. Constraints on creativity in a marriage of fates. If it is God that is within us then it must be Satan who dims us #poetryport
